items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: they’d play me Dave Brubeck, Miles, Barney Kessel, Horace Silver, whatever.

ctx.x: And at what age was that kind of decision?

Early. The beginning of high school years, probably like 13, 14. And you know early teenager. And I had some friends in my town who were two brothers who played music and they would take me into their little room where they had their stash of records and they’d play me Dave Brubeck, Miles, Barney Kessel, Horace Silver, whatever. And so they were really hip and way ahead of the time. Of course then I went to my mother and told her I wanted to be a jazz musician. You have to realize I’m first generation, my parents…
Did you go the garage band route at all?
